result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback: the Company has a 30-day convenience right, post-termination prepaid fees are refunded, the Termination Payment is capped at three months’ fees, and HDI may terminate for convenience only at term-end on 90 days’ notice. However, adding a right to terminate “in whole or in part” is unnecessary and creates an undefined partial-termination right that may alter unrelated scope and pricing expectations. Subsection (a) also remains drafted to apply broadly to any Company termination other than the specified carve-outs, rather than expressly only to convenience termination. The language is generally workable but not fully precise or minimal.
